title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Debugging in AL
summary: A blog series covering AL debugging techniques in Dynamics 365 Business Central, including snapshot debugging, conditional breakpoints, debugging from the web client, and advanced debugger features for development and troubleshooting.
key_points: Multiple debugging approaches available: snapshot debugging in cloud, conditional breakpoints, publish/debug separation with keyboard shortcuts
Debugger enhancements include IntelliSense for variables, SQL lock visibility, and ability to exclude try functions and temporary records
Debugging can be triggered from the web client and attached to specific user sessions or phone/tablet clients
Advanced features include NonDebuggable attribute to protect methods, debugging upgrade/install code, and connecting to on-premises instances

quotes.text: Debugging Upgrade and Install code in Visual Studio Code
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights specialized debugging capability for upgrade and install scenarios, which are critical operations in Business Central deployments
